item.title: Noppe: Niigata's Comforting Root Vegetable Stew — Guide
item.description: Noppe (or noppei-jiru) is a traditional Niigata comfort dish, a gently simmered stew combining root vegetables like taro and carrot with mushrooms, konjac and often seafood such as salmon or scallop, bound in a light, slightly thickened broth. The dish varies considerably from household to household and season to season, but it holds a special place in Niigata’s New Year celebrations, when it’s traditionally prepared in larger batches and served slightly cool, its comforting simplicity representing a homely counterpoint to the region’s more elaborate seafood and sake specialities.
